name: Smartloc
positioning: Rental management for the private landlord with the applicant file verification built into the same flow.
description: Smartloc offers French landlords an online rental management service: candidate application collection with document checking, lease generation and electronic signature, rent calls and receipts, payment tracking, and rent guarantee options.
real_estate_use: Self-managing landlords make their worst decision at selection, not at management, and the document verification step is where a service earns its fee. Smartloc chains verification, lease signature and rent tracking so the landlord does not stitch together three tools around the moment the tenant is chosen.
features: Candidate application collection with document verification
Lease generation with the applicable French regime
Electronic signature on lease and annexes
Rent calls, receipts and payment tracking

use_cases.job: Verify an applicant's documents before signing rather than after a default
Run selection, signature and rent tracking without assembling three tools
